panels.title: Live Campus Status Map
panels.description: Current building status and campus location context.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "snmp" and
    r._field == "sysUpTime"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["source"])
  |> last()          // one row per device
  |> group()         // ← collapse to ONE table
  |> count()

panels.title: Buildings Online
panels.description: Buildings currently represented by reporting infrastructure.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ups")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ups_up")
  |> group(columns: ["building", "ups_name"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> count()

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fortigate_healthcheck_v2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_loss_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> mean(column: "_value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "interface" and
    r.sysName == "FortigateA-Sccc.sccc.edu" and
    (r._field == "ifHCInOctets" or r._field == "ifHCOutOctets") and
    (r.ifName == "port25" or r.ifName == "port9")
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 8.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["_time"], mode: "by")
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "isp_current_total_bps")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "interface" and
    (r._field == "ifHCInOctets" or r._field == "ifHCOutOctets") and
    (
      r.source == "192.168.2.70" or
      r.source == "192.168.2.71" or
      r.source == "192.168.2.72" or
      r.source == "192.168.2.73"
    )
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> tail(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      switch:
        if r.source == "192.168.2.70" then "sw-aa144-A48" else
        if r.source == "192.168.2.71" then "sw-aa144-A24" else
        if r.source == "192.168.2.72" then "sw-t122-T24" else
        if r.source == "192.168.2.73" then "sw-t122-T48" else
        r.source,
      _value: r._value * 8.0
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["switch"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> yield(name: "nexus_current_bps_by_switch")

            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.195", DeviceType: "Aruba"},

            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.197", DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.199", DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.200", DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.201", DeviceType: "Aruba"},

            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.203", DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.204", DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.205", DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {SwitchIP: "192.168.2.212", DeviceType: "Aruba"}
        ]
    )
    |> group(columns: ["SwitchIP"])

recent_switches =
    from(bucket: "telegraf")
        |> range(start: -15m)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "snmp" and
            r._field == "sysUpTime"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["source"])
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            SwitchIP: string(v: r.source),
            OnlineFlag: 1
        }))
        |> group(columns: ["SwitchIP"])

switch_counts =
    join.left(
        left: expected_switches,
        right: recent_switches,
        on: (l, r) => l.SwitchIP == r.SwitchIP,
        as: (l, r) => ({
            SwitchIP: l.SwitchIP,
            DeviceType: l.DeviceType,
            ExpectedCount: 1,
            OnlineCount: if exists r.OnlineFlag then r.OnlineFlag else 0
        })
    )
    |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])
    |> reduce(
        identity: {DeviceType: "", ExpectedCount: 0, OnlineCount: 0},
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
            DeviceType: if accumulator.DeviceType != "" then accumulator.DeviceType else r.DeviceType,
            ExpectedCount: accumulator.ExpectedCount + r.ExpectedCount,
            OnlineCount: accumulator.OnlineCount + r.OnlineCount
        })
    )

expected_ups =
    from(bucket: "telegraf")
        |> range(start: -90d)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "ups" and
            r._field == "ups_up"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["building", "ups_name"])
        |> last()
        |> group(columns: [])
        |> count(column: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            DeviceType: "UPS",
            ExpectedCount: int(v: r._value),
            OnlineCount: 0
        }))

online_ups =
    from(bucket: "telegraf")
        |> range(start: -24h)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "ups" and
            r._field == "ups_up"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["building", "ups_name"])
        |> last()
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
        |> group(columns: [])
        |> count(column: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            DeviceType: "UPS",
            ExpectedCount: 0,
            OnlineCount: int(v: r._value)
        }))

ups_counts =
    union(tables: [expected_ups, online_ups])
        |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])
        |> reduce(
            identity: {DeviceType: "UPS", ExpectedCount: 0, OnlineCount: 0},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
                DeviceType: "UPS",
                ExpectedCount: accumulator.ExpectedCount + r.ExpectedCount,
                OnlineCount: accumulator.OnlineCount + r.OnlineCount
            })
        )

all_counts =
    union(tables: [switch_counts, ups_counts])
        |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])

device_types =
    array.from(
        rows: [
            {DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {DeviceType: "Cisco"},
            {DeviceType: "Fortigate"},
            {DeviceType: "UPS"}
        ]
    )
    |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])

join.left(
    left: device_types,
    right: all_counts,
    on: (l, r) => l.DeviceType == r.DeviceType,
    as: (l, r) => ({
        DeviceType: l.DeviceType,
        Online:
            if exists r.OnlineCount then r.OnlineCount else 0,
        Offline:
            if exists r.ExpectedCount and exists r.OnlineCount then r.ExpectedCount - r.OnlineCount
            else if exists r.ExpectedCount then r.ExpectedCount
            else 0
    })
)
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> sort(columns: ["DeviceType"])
    |> keep(columns: ["DeviceType", "Online", "Offline"])

        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "snmp" and
            r._field == "sysUpTime"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["source"])
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            SwitchIP: string(v: r.source),
            LastSeen: r._time,
            AgeSeconds: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0,
            SwitchName: if exists r.sysName then string(v: r.sysName) else "",
            Description: if exists r.sysDescr then string(v: r.sysDescr) else "",
            HasSysUpTime: true
        }))
        |> group(columns: ["SwitchIP"])

    join.left(
        left: expected,
        right: live,
        on: (l, r) => l.SwitchIP == r.SwitchIP,
        as: (l, r) => ({
            SwitchIP: l.SwitchIP,
            Building: l.Building,
            Role: l.Role,
            DeviceType: l.DeviceType,
            Status: if exists r.HasSysUpTime and r.HasSysUpTime == true then "Online" else "Offline",
            SwitchName: if exists r.SwitchName then r.SwitchName else "",
            Description: if exists r.Description then r.Description else "",
            LastSeen: if exists r.LastSeen then r.LastSeen else time(v: 0),
            Minutes: if exists r.AgeSeconds then r.AgeSeconds / 60.0 else -1.0
        })
    )

joined
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        Source: r.SwitchIP,
        Status: r.Status,
        SwitchName: r.SwitchName,
        Description: r.Description,
        Building: r.Building,
        Role: r.Role,
        DeviceType: r.DeviceType,
        LastSeen: r.LastSeen,
        Minutes: r.Minutes
    }))
    |> keep(columns: ["Source", "Status", "SwitchName", "Description", "Building"])
    |> sort(columns: ["Status", "Building", "Source"])
